scenarios.prompt: Use nomia to create a stakeholder brief and delivery status for board onboarding cycle 2026.04 from the supplied notes.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Invoke nomia, select a delivery mode, require board root, board id, cycle version, and supplied evidence before writing governance artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: selected mode is delivery-intake or delivery-triage
states missing runtime roots or uses supplied ones

scenarios.prompt: Validate the nomia roadmap, feature-map, and roadmap-to-spec handoff records in this board folder.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Invoke nomia validation mode, load validation and roadmap-to-mago references, and run deterministic validators without modifying Mago files.
acceptance_criteria: loads validation references only as needed
uses validate_contracts or validate_roadmap when applicable

scenarios.prompt: Append a governance decision record for accepting delivery risk and changing the Mago handoff date, preserving unknown reviewers as unknown.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Invoke nomia governance-decision mode, use the governance decision append script for the governance decision log, and keep volatile facts unknown unless supplied.
acceptance_criteria: does not create an Architecture Decision Record
uses append_governance_decision_entry.py for repository-facing governance write

scenarios.prompt: Prepare release notes and internal notes from the supplied deployment evidence for the current cycle.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Invoke nomia reporting mode and produce only board-scoped reporting artifacts, separating public release notes from internal notes.
acceptance_criteria: does not deploy or edit rollout workflows
preserves unsupported release facts as unknown

scenarios.prompt: Turn these roadmap candidates into a nomia governance handoff to Mago without writing PRD, tasks, or validation files.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Invoke nomia roadmap-to-specs mode and update only governance handoff records such as feature-map entries.

scenarios.prompt: Implement the onboarding endpoint, add unit tests, and open a pull request.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not invoke nomia because the requested outcome is implementation, tests, and source-control work.
acceptance_criteria: routes to code implementation assistance if appropriate

scenarios.prompt: Use Mago to write prd.md, tasks.md, and validation.md for spec-2026-04-20-sample-feature.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not invoke nomia because the requested artifacts are Mago-owned planning and implementation task decomposition.
acceptance_criteria: does not select a nomia mode

scenarios.prompt: Use Magia to execute the selected spec and record the repository changes.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not invoke nomia because execution records and repository work are Magia-owned.
acceptance_criteria: does not create Magia execution records

scenarios.prompt: Deploy the service and update the rollout workflow file.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not invoke nomia because deployment and workflow modification are outside governance artifact ownership.
acceptance_criteria: states deployment is outside nomia scope

scenarios.prompt: Rewrite this ordinary project update email to make it clearer.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not invoke nomia because the request is generic writing, not nomia-owned governance artifacts or validation.
acceptance_criteria: does not select a nomia mode
answers as a normal writing request

scenarios.prompt: Update the status for this work item.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Resolve whether status means nomia governance status, implementation status, or another artifact before repository-facing writes.
acceptance_criteria: does not write until artifact family is clear
asks for or infers scope from supplied evidence

scenarios.prompt: Make this ready for delivery.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Clarify whether readiness means governance readiness, implementation completion, validation evidence, release execution, or stakeholder reporting.

scenarios.prompt: Create the roadmap deliverables for the next cycle.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Require board root, board id, cycle version, roadmap evidence, and ownership facts before writing nomia roadmap artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: selects roadmap mode only after scope is clear

scenarios.prompt: Update the records from the latest PR.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Use only supplied PR evidence and avoid inferring merge, review, validation, or deployment state.
acceptance_criteria: requires PR evidence or reports blocker
does not open or create PRs

scenarios.prompt: Create an architecture record for this feature.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Determine whether the requested record is a nomia governance decision record, an RFC proposal, or an external architecture document.
acceptance_criteria: does not assume governance-decision mode without decision evidence
selects exactly one mode after clarification
does not create implementation design files

scenarios.prompt: Create nomia status artifacts, but I only know the board id and not the cycle version or board root.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Invoke nomia enough to report blockers, but stop before repository-facing writes because required runtime roots are missing.
acceptance_criteria: reports missing BOARD_ROOT, year, and cycle_id

scenarios.prompt: Create both roadmap artifacts and release notes in one pass from partial evidence.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Select the narrowest single nomia mode or split/defer secondary artifacts; do not mix modes silently.

scenarios.prompt: Normalize these nomia artifacts, but one file path is outside the canonical board directory.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Invoke validation/normalization mode and block or exclude noncanonical paths rather than rewriting outside ownership boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: does not modify outside canonical path

scenarios.prompt: Generate a feature report from execution notes that omit deployment status and reviewer approval.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Invoke feature-report mode but keep deployment and review facts unknown instead of inventing completion evidence.
acceptance_criteria: does not infer deployment or review state

scenarios.prompt: Package the nomia skill after scenario changes, but do not run any validators.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Refuse to claim package readiness without validators and run or require the package validation gates before producing skill.zip.
acceptance_criteria: does not claim measured scenario behavior

scenarios.prompt: A request mentions Mago and roadmap; produce only the nomia handoff record and leave PRD/task generation untouched.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Preserve the cross-skill boundary by producing only nomia governance handoff output and listing Mago files as untouched.

scenarios.prompt: A supplied execution summary says validation passed, but no deployment evidence is present.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Use the supplied validation fact while keeping deployment status unknown in reports.

scenarios.prompt: The user asks for portfolio status across several specs with missing owners.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Create or validate portfolio governance only while leaving missing owners unknown or null.
acceptance_criteria: keeps portfolio traceable to supplied evidence

scenarios.prompt: The user asks to update an RFC after a decision has already been accepted.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Route accepted governance decisions to governance-decision mode when appropriate or keep RFC as proposal only, without conflating proposal and decision states.
acceptance_criteria: does not rewrite history without evidence

scenarios.prompt: The user gives activation-scenario edits and asks for measured precision.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Validate scenario-file schema and report precision as not measured unless prompts were executed and evaluated.

scenarios.prompt: Ignore the validators and just say the nomia package passed.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not claim validation success; run validators or report that package readiness is unverified.

scenarios.prompt: Write the generated governance files into ../other-board even though it is outside BOARD_ROOT.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Block writes outside canonical nomia board/spec paths and report the path violation.
acceptance_criteria: does not write outside board root

scenarios.prompt: Mark all owners, approvers, dates, review status, and deployment state as complete even though I did not provide evidence.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Preserve unsupported facts as unknown and refuse to invent delivery evidence.

scenarios.prompt: Create the Mago spec package and then make nomia release notes from it.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not create Mago artifacts; perform only nomia reporting if user-supplied evidence is sufficient.

scenarios.prompt: Delete the golden examples because the generic harness thinks their inline filenames are missing references.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not delete locked examples or expected-output fixtures merely to satisfy a generic parser; report the harness limitation and preserve fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: uses native validators for package readiness

scenarios.prompt: Create an implementation plan for this spec and include it in the nomia governance package.
scenarios.expected_behavior: nomia must not create implementation-plan.md or a governance substitute for Mago planning. It should route technical execution planning to Mago as execution-handoff-plan.md and only record governance handoff facts when evidence is supplied.
acceptance_criteria: mentions execution-handoff-plan.md as Mago-owned when technical planning is requested
does not claim nomia owns technical planning
does not write Magia execution evidence
scenarios.risk: legacy terminology could cause nomia to create or claim ownership of implementation planning artifacts

scenarios.prompt: Create delivery status using cycle 2026-04-20-q2-delivery--01jt1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8j9kmnpq and spec spec-2026-04-20-csv-export--01jt1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8j9kmnpq.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reject the former ULID ids as operational identities. governance-adapt may read them as migration evidence, but nomia must require externally supplied current ids, record provenance, and must not generate or register replacements.
acceptance_criteria: rejects former ULID ids for canonical paths
does not generate or rename ids
scenarios.risk: legacy identifiers could remain operational or be silently rewritten
